stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "The city will hire more traffic enforcers to ease congestion during the holidays."
choices: Additional traffic enforcers can help reduce congestion.
All drivers in the city violate traffic rules.
Traffic enforcers are paid more than other employees.
There will be no traffic after the holidays.
explanation: Hiring enforcers "to ease congestion" only makes sense if more enforcers can actually help reduce it.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "Please bring two valid IDs when you claim your package."
choices: Packages can be claimed without visiting the office.
Most packages are lost in transit.
Identification is needed to confirm who is claiming the package.
Everyone owns more than five IDs.
explanation: Asking for IDs assumes the office needs to confirm the identity of the person claiming.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "Apply early to avoid the long lines on the last day of filing."
choices: Many applicants file on the last day.
The filing deadline will be extended.
Lines are short on the last day.
Early applicants receive a discount.
explanation: The advice assumes lines are long on the last day, which happens when many people file then.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "The school will offer free tutoring sessions to improve students' reading scores."
choices: Tutoring can help improve students' reading.
Reading scores are not important.
Teachers do not know how to teach reading.
All students are currently failing reading.
explanation: Offering tutoring "to improve" scores assumes tutoring can help. Nothing suggests that all students are failing.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "Our water filter removes 99% of bacteria. Buy one to keep your family safe."
choices: Tap water may contain harmful bacteria.
Bacteria can be seen with the naked eye.
Water filters are given away for free.
All families already own water filters.
explanation: Removing bacteria keeps a family "safe" only if the water may contain harmful bacteria.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "The library extended its hours until 9 p.m. to serve working students."
choices: Some working students can visit the library only in the evening.
The library will close on weekends.
Working students do not like to read.
Librarians prefer to work at night.
explanation: Extending evening hours for working students assumes that some of them can come only after work or class.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "Employees are reminded to turn off the lights and air conditioners before leaving, to reduce electricity costs."
choices: Leaving appliances on adds to electricity costs.
Employees never go home on time.
The office has no air conditioners.
Electricity is free at night.
explanation: The reminder assumes that appliances left on use electricity that adds to the bill.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "To reduce the spread of dengue, residents are urged to remove stagnant water around their homes."
choices: Residents never clean their surroundings.
Dengue spreads through contaminated food.
Stagnant water can serve as a breeding place for mosquitoes.
Dengue only affects children.
explanation: Removing stagnant water reduces dengue only if mosquitoes that spread it breed in such water.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "The company will post its job openings on social media to reach more applicants."
choices: Newspapers are no longer printed.
The company has never hired anyone before.
Many potential applicants use social media.
Social media posts never contain errors.
explanation: Posting on social media "to reach more applicants" assumes many potential applicants are there.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "Read the instructions carefully before answering the test."
choices: The test has no instructions.
The test is very easy.
Reading the instructions can help test takers answer correctly.
Test takers have seen the questions before.
explanation: The advice assumes the instructions contain information that affects how to answer.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "Bring an umbrella; the forecast says it will rain this afternoon."
choices: The speaker owns several umbrellas.
Umbrellas are expensive.
It rains every afternoon.
The weather forecast is reasonably reliable.
explanation: The advice relies on the forecast, so it assumes the forecast can be trusted.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "The agency replaced its paper forms with online forms to speed up processing."
choices: Online forms can be processed faster than paper forms.
All of the paper forms were lost.
Online forms are longer than paper forms.
Clients prefer to visit the office in person.
explanation: Switching "to speed up processing" assumes online forms are faster to process.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "Wear a helmet; it could save your life in an accident."
choices: Helmets are required only at night.
Every rider will have an accident.
Helmets can reduce the risk of serious head injury.
Riding a motorcycle is illegal.
explanation: The claim that a helmet could save a life assumes helmets protect against serious injury. It does not assume accidents are certain.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "The new evacuation center will be built on higher ground."
choices: The mayor lives on higher ground.
Evacuation centers are never used.
The old center was too large.
Higher ground is less likely to be flooded.
explanation: Choosing higher ground for an evacuation center assumes it is safer from floods.

stem:
Which of the following is an assumption implicit in the statement?
Statement: "Students who want to join the debate team must first pass an audition."
choices: No student wants to join the debate team.
The debate team has won many awards.
The audition will be held online.
Not every student who wants to join will be accepted.
explanation: Requiring an audition implies screening, which assumes some who want to join may not get in.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
All employees in the records section have completed the data privacy training. Jose works in the records section.
choices: Jose will conduct the next training.
Jose has completed the data privacy training.
Jose is the head of the records section.
Only the records section took the training.
explanation: If all records section employees completed the training and Jose is one of them, he completed it.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
In a survey of 500 commuters, 80% said they would use a bike lane if one were built along the main road.
choices: Commuters dislike public transportation.
The bike lane has already been built.
All residents of the city own bicycles.
Many of the surveyed commuters are open to biking along the main road.
explanation: The survey only shows that most respondents said they would use a bike lane. It says nothing about all residents, or about the lane existing.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
Sales of electric fans in the province this April were double those of last April.
choices: More electric fans were sold this April than last April.
This April was the hottest month in history.
Every household in the province bought a new fan.
Air conditioners are no longer sold in the province.
explanation: Doubled sales directly mean more fans were sold. The other choices may or may not be true; the data alone does not show them.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
Since the barangay installed streetlights on Mabini Street, reported thefts there have dropped by half.
choices: The drop in thefts on Mabini Street came after the streetlights were installed.
Thefts have increased in other barangays.
No thefts occur on Mabini Street anymore.
Streetlights prevent every kind of crime.
explanation: The information shows thefts fell by half after the lights went up. Thefts did not stop entirely, and nothing is said about other crimes or places.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
Only applicants with at least two years of experience will be interviewed. Maria has one year of experience.
choices: Maria will be hired.
Maria will not be interviewed.
Maria has more experience than the other applicants.
Maria will be interviewed first.
explanation: Maria has less than two years of experience, so she does not qualify for an interview.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
Every committee member voted, and the proposal passed by a majority of the votes.
choices: The proposal was rejected.
Some members did not vote.
All members voted in favor of the proposal.
More than half of the votes were in favor of the proposal.
explanation: A majority means more than half. A majority does not require every vote, and every member did vote.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
The bus leaves the terminal every 30 minutes, starting at 6:00 a.m. Ana arrived at the terminal at 7:10 a.m.
choices: Ana arrived just in time for the 7:00 a.m. bus.
The next bus after Ana arrived leaves at 7:15 a.m.
The next bus after Ana arrived leaves at 8:00 a.m.
The next bus after Ana arrived leaves at 7:30 a.m.
explanation: Buses leave at 6:00, 6:30, 7:00, 7:30, and so on. The 7:00 bus had already left when Ana arrived at 7:10, so the next is 7:30.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
Ramon is older than Liza. Liza is older than Carlo.
choices: Carlo is the oldest of the three.
Liza is the youngest of the three.
Ramon and Carlo are the same age.
Ramon is older than Carlo.
explanation: Ramon > Liza > Carlo in age, so Ramon is older than Carlo.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
Most of the residents who attended the town hall meeting supported the new market project.
choices: Every resident of the town supports the project.
The project had support among the residents who attended the meeting.
No one at the meeting opposed the project.
The project has been completed.
explanation: "Most" of the attendees supported it. That does not mean every resident or every attendee did.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
Of the 40 employees in the office, 25 take the bus to work and 10 drive. The rest walk.
choices: Fifteen employees walk to work.
Twenty-five employees walk to work.
Ten employees walk to work.
Five employees walk to work.
explanation: 40 − 25 − 10 = 5 employees walk.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
Documents submitted after the deadline will not be processed. Pedro's documents were processed.
choices: Pedro submitted his documents on or before the deadline.
Pedro submitted his documents after the deadline.
Pedro was not required to submit documents.
Pedro's documents were incomplete.
explanation: Late documents are never processed. Pedro's were processed, so they were not late.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
The price of a sack of rice rose by 10% in January and then fell by 10% in February.
choices: At the end of February, the price was the same as at the start of January.
At the end of February, the price was 20% lower than at the start of January.
At the end of February, the price was slightly lower than at the start of January.
At the end of February, the price was higher than at the start of January.
explanation: A price of 100 becomes 110 after a 10% rise, then 110 × 0.90 = 99 after a 10% fall: slightly lower than the start.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
In a class of 30, every student who scored above 90 received a medal. Twelve students received medals.
choices: At most twelve students scored above 90.
Eighteen students failed the test.
No student scored exactly 90.
Exactly twelve students scored above 90.
explanation: Everyone above 90 got a medal, so there can be no more than 12 such students. Medals may also have gone to others, so it may be fewer than 12.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
Whenever the river rises above the warning level, classes in the town are suspended. Classes were held today.
choices: Classes will be suspended tomorrow.
The river rose above the warning level today.
The river did not rise above the warning level today.
It did not rain today.
explanation: If the river had risen above the warning level, classes would have been suspended. They were held, so it did not.

stem:
Which conclusion is best supported by the information given?
Ana finished the report before Ben did. Carlo finished after Ben did.
choices: Carlo finished first.
Ana and Carlo finished at the same time.
Ben finished last.
Ana finished before Carlo.
explanation: The order is Ana, then Ben, then Carlo, so Ana finished before Carlo.
